scope: Historical stock signal event study; no account wealth, options returns, orders, or scheduling.

checks.required: Each day universe chosen only from current-directory eligibility plus complete daily history strictly before that day; disclose current directory is non-PIT and sample is not a historical all-market universe.
Specify opening print/bar-open versus prior-session-close anchor; gap-down from yesterday and intraday flush are different hypotheses.
Bar start-time t becomes knowable after t+1. No full bar high/low/close used to fill an order at the start or inside the same bar.
Running minimum may only incorporate bars observed so far, never session-low or future low. A new running minimum cannot also produce a rebound from that same new low.
For a close signal at minute t, specify entry t+2 open if retaining an additional full minute latency. Exact timestamp missing is unfilled, not nearest available.
Require complete and valid early observation minutes through signal for primary paths, retain partial paths with reasons and no forward fill.
Compare confirmed-rebound events to controls on same date and identical entry minute/horizon, not solely against a 10:01 unconditional baseline.
If testing rebound timing value, retain all initially eligible flushes including no-rebound outcomes and separate conditional matched-time baseline from an unconditional policy comparison.
Bid/ask unavailable: label fixed-bp costs as scenarios, open prints as proxies, never verified fills. Correct two-sided cost arithmetic and differing missing outcomes.
Predefine intraday or later horizon and exact clock semantics, including partial sessions. Exits before entries and non-trading dates invalid.
Save every eligible symbol-day x parameter configuration, all statuses and costs, including no drop, no rebound, missing data, bad data, and missing fill.
All registered candidate variants reported; no best variant called alpha. Correlated events/dates are not independent trial counts.
Predeclare time split or monthly diagnostics and do not use late holdout for selection; same sample after selection is descriptive.
No claim of executable 500-dollar whole-contract strategy or 500-to10000 potential from stock-event returns.
